title: 🤖 Add continuous corner smoothing to StyleBoxFlat
body: > [!INFO] > *AI disclosure*: Co-authored with OpenAI Codex, which assisted with implementation, iteration, validation, and documentation. The contributor directed the design, manually reviewed the changes, and remains responsible for the contribution. ## What problem(s) does this PR solve? `StyleBoxFlat` only supports circular rounded corners. Continuous-curvature, squircle-like corners currently require textures, shaders, or custom drawing code. ## Additional information This PR adds a global `corner_smoothing` property in the range `[0.0, 1.0]`. `0.0` preserves the existing rendering path, while positive values use a superellipse. Its parametric power is `p = 2^(-corner_smoothing)`, making `1.0` equivalent to a fourth-order squircle. The smooth path retains `corner_detail + 1` samples per corner, positioned at equal tangent-angle intervals. Analytic tangents are used to derive normal offsets for fill, border, shadow, and antialiasing contours, including unequal per-side border widths, without fitting separate inner and outer curves. This is an alternative to #111483, which also explored normal offsets during development. Its current implementation uses fitted exponent and coordinate adjustments for the outer contour; this PR derives related contours from one sampled superellipse. Per-corner smoothing can be added if maintainers prefer that API. Very large inward offsets may cross the curve's evolute and produce self-intersections. No such artifacts were observed in the tested configurations. Validation performed: - macOS/OpenGL development build succeeds. - Formatting, XML pass. - Headless and visual tests cover circular and smoothed corners, unequal borders, antialiasing, and shadows.
